Hemochromatosis
Deﬁ nition
Hemochromatosis (iron overload) is a condition in which a
number of regulatory mechanisms for iron are inoperative. Th e 
primary result is the buildup of iron and pro-oxidant iron dam-
age of cells. Primary forms of hemochromatosis are hereditary,
while secondary hemochromatosis is due to an alternate condi-
tion such as liver disease.227, 228
